structural_change: h16x route (QW-H16Y, 6_final.odb + SPEF TT, h16x_violators in kit h16y_paths.txt): 164 endpoints.  (1) program SRAM rd_out -> raw capture p_cap -190.8 (108): the capture has no logic but the two 64x512 program stores sat MY, i.e. their rd_out face (LEF x=0) faced EAST, away from the FIFO column/prog_q (west): 3 x BUFx16 + ~480 ps wire (443 ps slew) per bit.  (2) calendar read q -227.9 (47): g_base -> 12-b start compare -> start_cal -> sel_g/read-enable fan-out over long wire -> 47-b row mux (fixed-issue flops spread over x 166-320 / y 39-291 um at 12% std-cell density).  (3) q -> issue fault -153.6, pending_index -> sched_q -104, rows -> cfg_fault -95.7 / sealed -57 / loading -40 (same spread cluster).  Clock skew 140 ps tile-wide.  h16y: program stores R0 (rd_out face west, 35 um from the FIFO column); RTL H16X=2 (exact, 0 edges; claude/qw-h16y-1021): start compares registered one edge early from prog_base (start_base_pre), q loaded every edge with a late start/run select (q consumed only when pending), issue fault split fault_c|fault_s. h16yb: no fence (fallback).
